New York Herald, 10 June 1866, p. 2, col. 5
claims.verbatim:
Bark Portia (Br), Jamison, Sunderland, 48 days, with coal,
to Arkell, Tufts & Co. May 7, during a strong SW gale, stove
rail and bulwarks and lost boat, galley and everything move-
able from deck; 25th, lat 43 53, lon 54 10, saw bark Zufriden-
heit (Prus), bound W.
